Mobile game provider Mynet Inc. acquires game titles developed by other companies, and extends the longevity of those games. Recently, the company has been working on new in-house game development, as well as contracted game development. Mynet believed that Alibaba Cloud would be an excellent choice for their business model of extending the longevity of game titles, as they offered attractive pricing while integrating new technologies.
